PujaWatch

Modern Iconmark Concepts · Built from Brand Story

Each mark is designed around PujaWatch's core: direction, presence, and intentional growth. The compass concept - is reimagined here alongside four other modern minimalist marks to form a cohesive brand identity suite.

01
Iconmark · Geometric Symbol
The Compass Rose

Four directional points — like a compass — but asymmetrical: the north point is longer, dominant, pointing up. Direction is the entire game in life coaching: people come without knowing which way to go, and leave with a north star. The compass marks are the W hidden in the lower three points; the upper point is the P's vertical stroke, elongated to convey aspiration and upward movement. At its center, a small filled circle — the self, grounded, from which all direction flows. The geometry is sharp and precise — it will look extraordinary on dark backgrounds.

Compass · Light
Directional. Asymmetric. Precise.
Compass · Dark
Cream points, gold core. Exceptional.
PujaWatch
Lockup · Butter BG
Icon + wordmark. Full impact.
02
Compass · P in the Ring
The Compass P

The original compass shape stays exactly as it is - four sharp diamond points, asymmetric north. It sits inside a thin circular housing, like a watch face. Where the north spike exits the ring, the arc of the ring on either side naturally forms the bowl of a P, with the spike as its stem. You don't see two things - you see one unified mark. The P is discovered, not forced.

Compass P · Light
P formed by ring arc + north spike.
Compass P · Dark
Gold arc glows on espresso.

03
Abstract - PW - Wings - Opening
The Opening Wings

Two sweeping abstract forms, mirroring each other - one the P, one the W, together suggesting wings opening, hands welcoming, a horizon expanding. This is the mark of arrival: the moment a coaching client finally feels seen. The left form grounds in espresso; the right ascends in gold. As a pair they are equal and opposite, in the same gesture of welcome that Puja offers every person who comes to her practice.

Wings - Light
Two forms. One welcome.
Wings - Dark
Mark on espresso ground.

04
Transition · Dimension · Growth · P
The Folding Ribbon P

In coaching, personal transformation is about moving through different dimensions of self-awareness. This mark features a continuous, 3D folded ribbon that forms the letter P. The overlapping segments of the ribbon are shaded with rich gradients of deep espresso, warm gold, and light gold to create realistic depth, highlighting the transition from one state of mind to another.

05
Threshold · Light · Emergence · P
The Ingebius Mark

Ingebius - from the Latin ingredi (to enter) and lux (light) - represents the threshold moment of transformation. This luminous mark shapes the letter P as a portal: a softly radiant form suggesting the first light entering a darkened space. Where the Compass P points direction, Ingebius illuminates the path forward. It is the mark of arrival, the instant a client steps through the door of their own becoming.
